sections.content: Combine hypothetical conditions with quizá, podría, sería, tendría and other conditional forms to imagine possible futures. Use qualifications to show that the scenario is uncertain.

items.spanish: Si viviéramos en otro lugar, quizá tendríamos una vida diferente.
items.english: If we lived somewhere else, perhaps we would have a different life.

items.spanish: En ese escenario, podría ocurrir algo inesperado.
items.english: In that scenario, something unexpected could happen.

items.spanish: Sería difícil saber qué resultado tendríamos.
items.english: It would be difficult to know what outcome we would have.

items.spanish: Si cambiara la situación, probablemente cambiarían nuestras decisiones.
items.english: If the situation changed, our decisions would probably change.

sections.content: A hypothetical answer can contain both a condition and a probability marker to show degrees of uncertainty.
